ontology.label: Glossarist Ontology
ontology.comment: An OWL ontology for the Glossarist concept model. Builds on and extends multiple ISO standards: ISO 10241-1 (terminology entries), ISO 30042/TBX (data exchange), ISO 12620 (data category registry), ISO 25964/SKOS (thesaurus interoperability), ISO 639/15924/24229 (language/script/system identifiers). Design principles: - gloss:Concept rdfs:subClassOf skos:Concept — instant SKOS interop - gloss:Designation rdfs:subClassOf skosxl:Label — SKOS-XL pattern - Designations are separate named resources, linked via skosxl:prefLabel / skosxl:altLabel - Relationship subtypes reuse iso-thes: properties directly (broaderGeneric, etc.) - Source provenance uses prov:qualifiedDerivation - SKOS ConceptSchemes for all enumeration values (taxonomies/)

gloss:Concept.label: Concept
gloss:Concept.comment: A managed terminology concept — the top-level entity in Glossarist. Has status, dates, domains, related concepts, and localizations. Corresponds to ManagedConcept in glossarist-ruby.

gloss:ConceptCollection.label: Concept Collection
gloss:ConceptCollection.comment: A managed collection of concepts (a glossary or register). Corresponds to ManagedConceptCollection in glossarist-ruby.

gloss:LocalizedConcept.label: Localized Concept
gloss:LocalizedConcept.comment: A concept in a specific language. Contains designations, definition, notes, examples, sources. Linked to its managed concept via gloss:isLocalizationOf. Corresponds to LocalizedConcept in glossarist-ruby.

gloss:Designation.label: Designation
gloss:Designation.comment: Abstract base for all designation types. A designation is both a gloss:Designation and a skosxl:Label. The xl:literalForm carries the designation text. Corresponds to Designation::Base in glossarist-ruby.

gloss:Expression.label: Expression
gloss:Expression.comment: A word or phrase used as a designation.

gloss:Abbreviation.label: Abbreviation
gloss:Abbreviation.comment: A shortened form of a word or phrase (acronym, initialism, or truncation).

gloss:Symbol.label: Symbol
gloss:Symbol.comment: A non-letter symbol representing a concept.

gloss:LetterSymbol.label: Letter Symbol
gloss:LetterSymbol.comment: A single letter used as a symbol.

gloss:Prefix.label: Prefix Designation
gloss:Prefix.comment: A prefix that attaches before a designation (ISO 12620).

gloss:Suffix.label: Suffix Designation
gloss:Suffix.comment: A suffix that attaches after a designation (ISO 12620).

gloss:Pronunciation.label: Pronunciation
gloss:Pronunciation.comment: A pronunciation or transcription entry for a designation. Supports IPA, romanization, and other transcription systems.

gloss:GrammarInfo.label: Grammar Information
gloss:GrammarInfo.comment: Grammatical information about a designation: gender, number, part of speech.

gloss:DetailedDefinition.label: Detailed Definition
gloss:DetailedDefinition.comment: A definition, note, or example with optional per-item sources. Uses rdf:value for the text content.

gloss:ConceptSource.label: Concept Source
gloss:ConceptSource.comment: Bibliographic source with type (authoritative/lineage), status (identical/modified/...), and an origin citation.

gloss:Reference.label: Reference
gloss:Reference.comment: A typed reference to an item within a collection. Used for domain classification (ManagedConceptData#domains) and typed references (ConceptData#references). For bibliographic citations, use gloss:Citation. For concept links in relationships, use gloss:ConceptRef.

gloss:RelatedConcept.label: Related Concept
gloss:RelatedConcept.comment: A concept with a typed relationship (deprecates, broader, equivalent, etc.).

gloss:ConceptDate.label: Concept Date
gloss:ConceptDate.comment: MANAGEMENT: A governance event in the concept or localization lifecycle. Types include acceptance, amendment, retirement, review, and review decision. Inspired by TBX <transactionGrp> (ISO 30042).

gloss:NonVerbalRepresentation.label: Non-Verbal Representation
gloss:NonVerbalRepresentation.comment: Reference to an external image, table, or formula resource (ISO 10241-1 §6.5).

gloss:Citation.label: Citation
gloss:Citation.comment: A bibliographic citation. The ref field is always a structured CitationRef hash (source + id + optional version). Never a plain string in V3. Used as the origin of ConceptSource. Corresponds to Citation in glossarist-ruby.

gloss:CitationRef.label: Citation Reference
gloss:CitationRef.comment: Inner reference of a Citation — always a structured hash with source, id, and optional version. Never a plain string in V3. Corresponds to Citation::Ref in glossarist-ruby.

gloss:ConceptRef.label: Concept Reference
gloss:ConceptRef.comment: A reference to a concept in another registry or vocabulary. Has source and id only — no version, locality, or link. Used as the ref of RelatedConcept. Corresponds to ConceptRef in glossarist-ruby.

gloss:Locality.label: Locality
gloss:Locality.comment: A locality within a cited document (section, clause, page, etc.).

gloss:CustomLocality.label: Custom Locality
gloss:CustomLocality.comment: A custom name-value locality pair within a citation.

gloss:DesignationRelationship.label: Designation Relationship
gloss:DesignationRelationship.comment: A typed relationship between designations (e.g. abbreviated_form_for, short_form_for). The target is a designation string, not a concept reference.

gloss:hasLocalization.label: has localization
gloss:hasLocalization.comment: Links a managed concept to one of its language-specific localizations.

gloss:isLocalizationOf.label: is localization of
gloss:isLocalizationOf.comment: Links a localized concept back to its managed concept.

gloss:hasStatus.label: has status
gloss:hasStatus.comment: Concept lifecycle status (draft, valid, superseded, etc.).

gloss:hasDomain.label: has domain
gloss:hasDomain.comment: Links a concept to a domain (subject area) classification.

gloss:hasRelatedConcept.label: has related concept
gloss:hasRelatedConcept.comment: DATA: Typed semantic relationship — applicable at concept, localization, and designation levels.

gloss:hasDate.label: has date
gloss:hasDate.comment: MANAGEMENT: Governance date/event — applicable at concept and localization levels.

gloss:hasSource.label: has source
gloss:hasSource.comment: DATA: Bibliographic source — applicable at concept, localization, designation, definition, and non-verbal representation levels.

gloss:identifier.label: identifier
gloss:identifier.comment: The management identifier for the concept.

gloss:uri.label: URI
gloss:uri.comment: Optional URI for the managed concept.

gloss:hasEntryStatus.label: has entry status
gloss:hasEntryStatus.comment: Localized entry lifecycle status (valid, not_valid, superseded, retired).

gloss:hasDesignation.label: has designation
gloss:hasDesignation.comment: Links a localized concept to one of its designations (terms/symbols).

gloss:hasDefinition.label: has definition
gloss:hasDefinition.comment: Links a localized concept to a definition.

gloss:hasNote.label: has note
gloss:hasNote.comment: Links a localized concept to a supplementary note.

gloss:hasExample.label: has example
gloss:hasExample.comment: Links a localized concept to an illustrative example.

gloss:hasNonVerbalRep.label: has non-verbal representation
gloss:hasNonVerbalRep.comment: Links a localized concept to a non-verbal representation resource.

gloss:classification.label: classification
gloss:classification.comment: DATA: Classification of the localized entry (admitted, preferred).

gloss:hasReference.label: has reference
gloss:hasReference.comment: DATA: Typed concept reference at the localization level.

gloss:language.label: language
gloss:language.comment: DATA: ISO 639 three-character language code. Cascades: L10n → Designation → Pronunciation.

gloss:release.label: release
gloss:release.comment: Release version of this localized concept.

gloss:lineageSimilarity.label: lineage similarity
gloss:lineageSimilarity.comment: Similarity percentage to the lineage source.

gloss:reviewType.label: review type
gloss:reviewType.comment: Type of review for the localized entry (editorial or substantive).

gloss:normativeStatus.label: normative status
gloss:normativeStatus.comment: Normative status of a designation (preferred, admitted, deprecated, superseded). Preferred designations SHOULD also be typed as iso-thes:PreferredTerm; others as iso-thes:SimpleNonPreferredTerm.

gloss:isInternational.label: is international
gloss:isInternational.comment: Whether the designation is valid across all languages/regions.

gloss:isAbsent.label: is absent
gloss:isAbsent.comment: The designation is explicitly absent for this concept in this language.

gloss:register.label: register
gloss:register.comment: Register or usage level of the designation (ISO 12620 / TBX-Linguist: colloquial_register, neutral_register, technical_register, in_house_register, bench_level_register, slang_register, vulgar_register).

gloss:fieldOfApplication.label: field of application
gloss:fieldOfApplication.comment: Subject field in which the designation is used.

gloss:text.label: text
gloss:text.comment: Textual representation of a letter or graphical symbol.

gloss:image.label: image
gloss:image.comment: URI to the graphical symbol image.

gloss:pronunciationSystem.label: pronunciation system
gloss:pronunciationSystem.comment: ISO 24229 conversion system code or simple identifier (e.g. IPA).

gloss:relationshipType.label: relationship type
gloss:relationshipType.comment: The type of relationship between concepts.

gloss:relationshipRef.label: relationship reference
gloss:relationshipRef.comment: Reference for the related concept (source + id).

gloss:refId.label: reference identifier
gloss:refId.comment: Item identifier within the collection (document ID, concept ID).

gloss:refVersion.label: reference version
gloss:refVersion.comment: Version of the item or collection.

gloss:refLink.label: reference link
gloss:refLink.comment: URL link to the source document or concept.

gloss:refType.label: reference type
gloss:refType.comment: Type qualifier: local, designation, urn, domain.

gloss:urn.label: URN
gloss:urn.comment: Direct URN reference to the target concept.

gloss:term.label: term
gloss:term.comment: Term text when referencing a concept.

gloss:sourceType.label: source type
gloss:sourceType.comment: Type of source: authoritative or lineage.

gloss:sourceStatus.label: source status
gloss:sourceStatus.comment: Status relative to source: identical, modified, etc.

gloss:sourceOrigin.label: source origin
gloss:sourceOrigin.comment: The bibliographic citation from which this concept was sourced.

gloss:modification.label: modification
gloss:modification.comment: How the concept was modified from the source.

gloss:hasCitationRef.label: has citation ref
gloss:hasCitationRef.comment: Structured inner reference (source + id + optional version).

gloss:citationRefSource.label: citation ref source
gloss:citationRefSource.comment: Document series or termbase (e.g. ISO, IEC).

gloss:conceptRefSource.label: concept ref source
gloss:conceptRefSource.comment: Registry or vocabulary identifier (e.g. IEC, ISO).

gloss:citationLink.label: citation link
gloss:citationLink.comment: URL link to the source document.

gloss:dateType.label: date type
gloss:dateType.comment: MANAGEMENT: Kind of governance event: accepted, amended, retired, review, review_decision.

gloss:eventDescription.label: event description
gloss:eventDescription.comment: MANAGEMENT: Free-text description of the governance event (e.g., review decision narrative).

gloss:representationType.label: representation type
gloss:representationType.comment: Type of representation: image, table, or formula.

gloss:representationText.label: representation text
gloss:representationText.comment: Alt text or description of the representation.

gloss:localityType.label: locality type
gloss:localityType.comment: Type of locality: section, clause, page, etc.

gloss:referenceFrom.label: reference from
gloss:referenceFrom.comment: Starting point of the locality reference.

gloss:referenceTo.label: reference to
gloss:referenceTo.comment: Ending point of the locality reference (for ranges).

gloss:partOfSpeech.label: part of speech
gloss:partOfSpeech.comment: Part of speech classification (ISO 12620 / TBX: noun, verb, adj, adverb, preposition, participle).

gloss:compares.label: compares
gloss:compares.comment: Comparative: this concept is compared to another.

gloss:contrasts.label: contrasts
gloss:contrasts.comment: Comparative: this concept contrasts with another.

gloss:hasHomograph.label: has homograph
gloss:hasHomograph.comment: Lexical: this concept has a homograph in another entry.

gloss:hasFalseFriend.label: has false friend
gloss:hasFalseFriend.comment: Lexical: this concept has a false friend in another language.

gloss:relatedConceptBroader.label: related concept (broader)
gloss:relatedConceptBroader.comment: Associative: related concept with broader scope.

gloss:relatedConceptNarrower.label: related concept (narrower)
gloss:relatedConceptNarrower.comment: Associative: related concept with narrower scope.

gloss:abbreviatedFormFor.label: abbreviated form for
gloss:abbreviatedFormFor.comment: This designation is an abbreviated form of the target designation.

gloss:shortFormFor.label: short form for
gloss:shortFormFor.comment: This designation is a short form of the target designation.

gloss:relationshipTarget.label: relationship target
gloss:relationshipTarget.comment: The target designation text for a designation-level relationship (string, not a concept ref).

gloss:conceptRefText.label: concept ref text
gloss:conceptRefText.comment: Human-readable text label for the referenced concept (e.g. the term or designation).

gloss:hasAnnotation.label: has annotation
gloss:hasAnnotation.comment: Links a localized concept to an annotation (editorial or explanatory note).
